Mature trees cast dappled, consistent shadows onto the asphalt. A painted center line divides the two lanes, curbs edge the road, and sidewalks run along both sides. Parked cars and low fences are visible in the background.

actions.description: Ego vehicle drives forward along the suburban road, the stopped yellow school bus visible ahead in the oncoming lane with red lights flashing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The bus's stop arm is fully extended; a child-shaped figure steps off the left curb and begins walking across the road in front of the bus. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle continues at normal cruising speed without slowing, closing distance on the stopped bus and the crossing child moving toward the ego lane. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
